catalog.title: Autonomous invoicing
catalog.headline: NL → invoice created & sent on PayPal, no approval needed (money-in)
catalog.detail: Money-in autonomy: natural language becomes a real PayPal invoice. No approval path exists for invoicing — it moves no money out.

catalog.title: Autonomous chase
catalog.headline: Overdue invoice → AI-drafted, tone-escalating reminder sent unattended
catalog.detail: The agent watches due dates, drafts the reminder itself (tone escalates per attempt) and sends it through PayPal — zero human involvement.

catalog.title: Gated payout (the money shot)
catalog.headline: $500 payout → GATE → AI risk summary → one-tap approve → executed & logged
catalog.detail: The centerpiece: money-out the agent PROPOSES, the engine GATES, a human approves in one tap. Watch the decision, the AI risk summary, and the settlement webhook.

catalog.title: The guardrail
catalog.headline: Off-policy payout to unknown payee → deterministically BLOCKED
catalog.detail: A payout to a payee who is not on the signed allowlist. No approval button exists — the engine refuses deterministically.

catalog.title: Audit everything
catalog.headline: Hash-chained audit log verified — every decision & money move inspectable
catalog.detail: The audit chain is recomputed record-by-record with SHA-256. Tamper with anything and this goes red.

catalog.title: Global stop
catalog.headline: Kill switch halts the agent; a live payout attempt is refused while halted
catalog.detail: Global stop: while the kill switch is on, a live money-out attempt is refused — approvals freeze too.

catalog.title: Speak your policy
catalog.headline: Plain English → mandate diff → human signature → new signed version
catalog.detail: Speak a policy change in plain English; the agent drafts the diff, a human signature turns it into a new signed mandate version.

catalog.title: Autonomous standing payout
catalog.headline: In-bounds weekly payout runs with NO prompt; drift falls back to GATE
catalog.detail: The agentic-commerce beat: a pre-authorized weekly payout executes with no human present — then a drifted amount is gated instantly.

catalog.title: Interrogate the trail
catalog.headline: Ask why an action was blocked; export a signed mandate receipt
catalog.detail: Ask the audit trail why something was blocked, get the counterfactual, and export a signed mandate receipt.

catalog.title: Impostor detection (the Netflix check)
catalog.headline: Inbound invoice claims Netflix → lookalike domain + outlier amount → IMPOSTOR
catalog.detail: An inbound invoice claims to be from Netflix — directory, sender-domain, amount-envelope and history checks decide if it is real. A lookalike domain with an inflated amount is caught as an impostor.

catalog.title: Subscription guard
catalog.headline: Real subscription verifies against its signed envelope; a price hike flags SUSPICIOUS
catalog.detail: The same checks, from the other side: the genuine Netflix bill verifies against its known envelope — and an official-sender price hike above it is flagged for review instead of silently paid.

catalog.title: Dispute evidence pack
catalog.headline: A payee disputes a payout → one signed artifact: approval + PayPal batch + settlement webhook + hash position
catalog.detail: When a payee disputes a charge, Mandate compiles the human approval record, the PayPal batch id, the settlement webhook and the hash-chain position into one signed, exportable evidence pack.
